78: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Reformed and fresh out of prison, Derek severs contact with the gang and becomes determined to keep Danny from going down the same violent path as he did.
334: The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them.
The most astonishing, innovative, backyard adventure of all time!
590: A rogue band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.
Empires are built on fear. Rebellions are built on hope.
846: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.
All you need is one killer track.
1102: A group of survivors take refuge in a shopping mall after the world is taken over by aggressive, flesh-eating zombies.
When there's no more room in Hell, the dead will walk the Earth.
1358: After Drax Industries' Moonraker space shuttle is hijacked, secret agent James Bond is assigned to investigate, traveling to California to meet the company's owner, the mysterious Hugo Drax. Where all the other Bonds end… this one begins!
1614: Through a series of flashbacks, four Chinese women born in America and their respective mothers born in feudal China explore their pasts.
Between every mother and daughter there is a story that must be told.
1870: Three eclectic, never-quite-famous folk bands come together for the first time in decades following the death of their manager to put on an reunion concert in his honor, at the request of his son.
Back together for the first time, again.

Be first. Be smarter. Or cheat.
2638: Escaping death, a Hebrew infant is raised in a royal household to become a prince. Upon discovery of his true heritage, Moses embarks on a personal quest to reclaim his destiny as the leader and liberator of the Hebrew people.
The greatest event in motion picture history!
2894: Debbie Ocean, a criminal mastermind, gathers a crew of female thieves to pull off the heist of the century at New York's annual Met Gala.
3150: Unhappily married, Julia Sturges decides to go to America with her two children on the Titanic. Her husband, Richard also arranges passage on the luxury liner so as to have custody of their two children. All this fades to insignificance once the ship hits an iceberg.
TITANIC in Emotion...in Spectacle...in Climax...in Cast!
3406: In Bodeen, Texas, an indie-rock loving misfit finds a way of dealing with her small-town misery after she discovers a roller derby league in nearby Austin.

4174: Two divers are left out at sea without a boat. There’s nothing but water for miles, unless they look at what’s underneath them...
4430: Three American college students studying abroad are lured to a Slovakian hostel, and discover the grim reality behind it.
Each year, over 10,000 people in America are killed with firearms. Approximately 2,000 more are stabbed to death. Americans...they have no imagination.
4686: Paul Reubens stars as Pee-wee Herman in his second full-length film about a farmer who joins the circus after a storm drops a big tent in his front yard. Pee-wee, along with an outlandish cast of animals and circus performers, puts on the best show ever.
4942: When Maureen Coyle, a suicidal nun who resembles Norman's former victim, Marion Crane, arrives at the motel, all bets are off and "Mother" is less than happy.
Norman Bates is back to normal. But mother's off her rocker again.

One family's tale of a homeland lost... and a homeland found.
5454: Sensitive rural town model student Steven Carter hides his gay feelings, except with his neighbor and best friend Linda. Suddenly his desperate search for partners leads to a blind date with golden boy John Dixon, bound for an Oxbridge career.
Boy meets boy. Boy likes boy. Boy, oh, boy.
5710: Jon and Garfield visit the United Kingdom, where a case of mistaken cat identity finds Garfield ruling over a castle. His reign is soon jeopardized by the nefarious Lord Dargis, who has designs on the estate.
2 much of a good thing is even better.
5966: The new warden of a small prison farm in Arkansas tries to clean it up of corruption after initially posing as an inmate.
One man against a cruel system.
6222: A man works for the unpleasant guru of a Scientology-like movement.
6478: Under the leadership of their counselor, teenagers at a juvenile detention center gain self-esteem by playing football together. Based on a true story.
6734: Nishi is a loser who has a crush on his childhood girlfriend. After an encounter with the Japanese mafia, he journeys to heaven and back, and ends up trapped in an even more unlikely place.
6990: In pre-unified China, the King of Qin sends his concubine to a rival kingdom to produce an assassin for a political plot, but as the king's cruelty mounts she finds her loyalty faltering.
7246: This is a drama set in Nazi-occupied France at the height of World War II. Charlotte Gray tells the compelling story of a young Scottish woman working with the French Resistance in the hope of rescuing her lover, a missing RAF pilot. Based on the best-selling novel by Sebastian Faulks.
The story of an ordinary woman in an extraordinary time.
7502: In 1943, while the Allies are bombing Berlin and the Gestapo is purging the capital of Jews, a dangerous love affair blossoms between two women – one a Jewish member of the underground, the other an exemplar of Nazi motherhood.
Bound By Desire. Torn Apart By War.
7758: Five medical students, hoping to understand the mystery of what lies beyond life, embark on a dangerous experiment. When their hearts are stopped for a short period of time, they have a near-death experience…
You haven't lived until you've died.
8270: Harassed by bullies because of his mild autism, teen Ben finds refuge in an online computer game, which leads him to his virtual dream girl, Scarlite. Together, the odd couple seeks revenge against Ben's tormentors.
8526: Dan Merrick comes out from a shattering car accident with amnesia. He finds that he is married to Judith who is trying to help him start his life again. A love he can't forget. A murder he can't remember.
8782: At the discovery of his ability to work miracles, Juvenal becomes a media sensation, but now he's prone to those who want to exploit him.
Everyone wants a piece of the action.
9038: Middle-aged Gerald Kingsland advertises in a London paper for a female companion to spend a year with him on a desert island. One Year on a Deserted Tropical Island. 'Wife' 20-30 needed to accompany man 35+. Write to Box 775 with details and evening phone number.
9294: Set during a sultry summer in a French suburb, Marie is desperate to join the local pool's synchronized swimming team, but is her interest solely for the sake of sport or for a chance to get close to Floriane, the bad girl of the team? Sciamma, and the two leads, capture the uncertainty of teenage sexuality with a sympathetic eye in this delicate drama of the angst of coming-of-age.
9550: North Face tells the story of two German climbers Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser and their attempt to scale the deadly North Face of the Eiger.
9806: The friendship of a group of young friends struggling with teen sex, drugs, and work is jeopardized by a romantic interest which may turn pals into bitter rivals.
The comedy that puts ZIP into being a teen...
10062: Xavier is a 40-year-old father of two who still finds life very complicated. When the mother of his children moves to New York, he can't bear them growing up far away from him and so he decides to move there as well.
10318: A young woman recuperating at her father's run-down home after a tragic accident soon encounters a terrifying presence with a connection to her long-deceased mother.
The dead are back for life.
10574: Petra von Kant is a successful fashion designer -- arrogant, caustic, and self-satisfied. She mistreats Marlene (her secretary, maid, and co-designer). Enter Karin, a 23-year-old beauty who wants to be a model. Petra falls in love with Karin and invites her to move in.

For centuries a treaty has existed between the human world and the realm of the demons.
11086: When a foreign-exchange student and a hooker - both named Dominique - show up on a college campus, the unsuspecting student body is in for the education of a lifetime!

Where the legend ends and the man begins.
11598: A writer whose lover is a woman widowed three times begins to suspect she may be responsible for her husbands' deaths.
Christine is young, beautiful and rich. Her three husbands all died tragically. It's time for Christine to find her fourth man.
12110: A film about Mark David Chapman in the days leading up to the infamous murder of Beatle John Lennon.
He came to New York to meet John Lennon... and the world changed forever.

This is the sound he created and performed. The rare personal films never before seen by the public. The private moments. The public triumphs. Intimate memories and reflections in his own words.
12622: In 1983, yacht sailor Will Parker leads an American crew financed by millionaire Morgan Weld to defeat during the America's Cup race against an Australian crew. The only thing better than winning the America's Cup is losing it... and winning it back.
12878: An aspiring young filmmaker gets involved with an eccentric gangster for the financing of his first film.
A comedy about getting in over your head.
13134: The new guy in a Los Angeles high school, Morgan, does some singing and fights hotshot Nick over disco dancer Frankie.
Meet Morgan Hiller. He's a rebel about to become a hero.

He is injected with the drug and abducted by the thieves. Amy has six hours to find the also stolen antidote and save Dean's life.
You can't stop a man who will stop at nothing.

The resulting battle between imagination and appropriation rips out of the rehearsal space and through all three women's lives.

What is dead may never die.

Also standing in their way is Sam, a disgruntled barista with delusions of grandeur and Will's heartache over unrequited love for Becca.

Now, as the police and an assassin called "The Mormon" track Ray, he and his attractive assistant, Lola, must clear their own names.
We keep your private life private.
15438: Three gutsy kids from a rapidly gentrifying Bronx neighborhood stumble upon a sinister plot to suck all the life from their beloved community.
They messed with the wrong neighborhood!
15694: Aging opera singer Maria Callas tries to make a comeback by performing in a production of Bizet's "Carmen."
A triumph is worse than a failure if the price is too high

For Oscar, every day is an adventure

At the end of the war, a group of Italian prisoners got lost on their way home. Their journey back transformed everyone they met along the way.
16718: Police inspector and excellent hostage negotiator Ho Sheung-Sang finds himself in over his head when he is pulled into a 72 hour game by a cancer suffering criminal out for vengeance on Hong Kong's organized crime syndicates.

Experience their lives on the road
17486: When a discredited L.A. Seismologist warns of an impending 12.7 earthquake, no one takes her seriously. Now on her own, she races desperately to get her family to safety before the earthquake breaks Los Angeles apart from the mainland.
17742: In the not-too-distant future, as a final response to crime and terrorism, the U.S. government plans to broadcast a signal that will make it impossible for anyone to knowingly break the law.
17998: When his father is lynched by a mob after being framed by a gangster, a young boy leaves his village along with his pregnant mother  and flees to Mumbai. He takes up a life of crime and swears to avenge his father. A remake of the 1990 film.
18510: After receiving an anonymous tip, a tax officer leads a raid on the mansion of the most powerful figure in Lucknow, a member of parliament who has been evading income tax for years.
Heroes Don't Always Come in Uniform
18766: Giulia De Martino is a pilot. At seventeen she participates in the GT Championship, under the guidance of her father Mario. But one day everything changes and Giulia has to face alone both the track and her own life.
19278: A lonely private investigator is contacted by a mysterious woman who pulls him into a mind game known as “telephone walking”. Fascinated by her voice, Aloys discovers an imaginary universe that allows him to break out of his isolation.

Nothing is more poisonous than the human heart.

Her life is just getting started. Again.

Risking their own lives, they will discover just what being a parent means and how far they will go to get their child back.

The real "problem" starts when Paul gets to know psychologist Margarethe Tietze whose relationship to her parents is also not so easy after all.

Over the past decade, lone survivor Andrew’s claims that local legend Victor Crowley was responsible for the horrific massacre have been met with great controversy. But when a twist of fate puts him back at the scene of the tragedy, Crowley is mistakenly resurrected and Andrew must face the bloodthirsty ghost from his past.

But as soon as the lies are revealed it becomes clear that they are not heroes saving their country but nothing more than paid assassins. Moreover, the producer of the game is keeping many more of the same CDs, so many more "heroes" like themselves could also be produced. Now the gamers have to find the CDs and either destroy them or create an army of gamers and rule over all. The team becomes divided into two, each pitted against the other

Despite the success, they must soon face up to the difficulties inherent in running a family business. Their brotherhood turns into rivalry, through no fault of their own.

23630: Returning to her home planet, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a team of unlikely heroes. Together, they battle monsters and dangerous bandits to protect a young girl who holds the key to unimaginable power.

You're never too small to dream big.

Taking matters into his own hands, Sonny seeks out his revenge teaming up with the most dangerous mob boss in town to get back what is rightfully his. When he finally comes face to face with his longtime friend he will be forced to make a life changing choice.

Ultimately, they must confront the question of what it means to love one another in the face of Tusker’s illness.

One warrior must unite them all.

Fikret decides to go to Deniz's house disguised as a priest but gets more than he bargained for.

The educated and modern Muslims are in a difficult situation because of their approach towards life and their western attire. They are criticized and harassed by the fundamentalists and on the other hand the Western world sees them as potential suspects of terrorism just because of their Muslim names.
25422: In an eastern Turkish town, suitors knock on the door of the mayor and father of three beautiful daughters who choose to follow their own paths.
25678: Karrer plods his way through life in quiet desperation. His environment is drab and rainy and muddy. But the lady is married and Karrer is determined to keep her husband away...
26190: Max S. reveals how he built a drug empire from his childhood bedroom in this story that inspired the series "How to Sell Drugs Online."
26446: In lawless storm ravaged New Orleans, eleaguered Detective Sean Riley is trying to cope with the death of his young son and the abandonment of his wife. The two quickly realize there is something far more sinister going on than either could have ever imagined.
His city. His rules. No prisoners.
26702: Sanjana is a vivacious young woman who lives life on her own terms. She becomes upset when her mother, Susheela, arranges for her to meet a boy as a potential marriage prospect.
26958: A gathering of friends is thrown into chaos by the opening of a mysterious fiery sinkhole near their secluded holiday home.
Nobody Is Getting Out of Here
27214: Biju is an honest policeman who fights the injustice head-on. In his pursuit to keep things under control and clean, he encounters a series of events and cases which test his authority, honesty and integrity. With a week to his wedding, what ensues is a heartfelt story of a cop sans the cinematic hype.
A ride with a police officer
27470: A middle-class corporate couple doesn't worry about money and living expenses until the recession drains their finances.
Vinod Kumar Sehgal a.k.a. V. K. Sehgal
27726: Johan is a two-fisted Gothenburg cop who finds himself in a shoot-out with jewel robbers. After the smoke has cleared, one robber, shot by his accomplice, and an innocent bystander, are dead. Gaut soon threatens the three witnesses, and only Johan, the badge-wearing hero, can save them.
27982: A young French journalist repeatedly meets iconic surrealist artist Salvador Dalí for a documentary project that never came to be.
Dalí is probably the only artist still living.
28238: Shekhar, a businessman, accidentally kills his associate Amar, and ridden with guilt, decides to watch over Amar's company and take care of his family and friends. However, he falls in love with Amar's fiancé Piya - who is to marry tycoon Abhi Gyan to save the company
28494: After people in his town start turning up dead, a grumpy landlord is visited by a man who recounts an unsolved serial murder case from 30 years ago that may hold the clue to what is happening now.
There is a serial killer in our town.
28750: After a rocky start, a friendship develops between a happy-go-lucky youth and a girl from the city.
29006: It is an unusual mix of two love stories: 'Father and Son' and 'Son and a Beautiful girl.
29262: Because of a bet, Werner and his friend have to construct the fastest vehicle to win a race, because life depends on it.
29518: A unit of American military advisors in Vietnam prior to the major U.S. involvement finds similarities between their helpless struggle against the Viet Cong and the doomed actions of a French unit at the same site a decade before.
We're getting strafed, shelled, bombed, and blasted. And it isn't even our damned war!
29774: Rip Porter is sentenced to seven years in prison for beating his wife, Wendy. When he is released, he discovers that Wendy gave up their child, and the privileged Campbell family adopted him. The two families are soon in a legal battle for the child they both love.
Sometimes the greatest love is letting go.
30030: Two days in the life of Mostafa Chamran, Iran's first post-revolutionary defense minister, as he attempts to prevent the city of Paveh from falling to Kurdish separatists in 1979.
30286: Through revealing interviews with experts and victims' families, this gripping documentary examines the problem of deadly foodborne illness in the US.
Self - Father, Food Safety Advocate, Professor
Self - President, Jack in the Box
30542: The year is 1914 and Richard Hannay, Mining Engineer who is visiting Britain for a short time before returning to South Africa, is shocked when one of his neighbours, Colonel Scudder, bursts into his rooms one night and tells him a story that Prussian 'sleeper' agents are planning to pre-start World War I by murdering a visiting foreign minister. Fleeing to Scotland Hannay attempts to clear his name and to stop the agents with the aid of Alex Mackenzie but not only is he is chased by Chief Supt Lomas for Scudder's death but by the agents who are headed by Appleton who has managed to hide himself in a high-placed position in the British Government...
Every second counts in the adventure of a lifetime!
30798: An entity is terrorizing a small Midwest town. Ludlow Falls continues to descend into madness and death as more young women are driven insane. Sometimes small towns hide big secrets and a town's sin will be exposed.

Some adults need to grow up.

Tony T. Chopper, the new Animal King!
31566: Christopher Columbus believes he can find an alternative route to the far East and persuades the King and Queen of Spain to finance his expedition...
31822: In the turbulent late Eastern Han Dynasty, ambitious Dong Zhuo controls the court and the commonalty, and heroes from all over the country begin to rise.
Master of the Sword Forge Castle
32078: 9-year old orphan called Rasmus runs away from the orphanage. He meets a vagabond they call Paradise Oskar who likes to sing and play his accordion. Oskar makes the Rasmus world seem like a better place.

A portrait of genius music composer Ryuichi Sakamoto.

It's a RIOT how Cary carries on!

Since the closer to the bottom of the ocean, the darker it gets...

Obsession can blur the lines of reality.

From the World's Master Film Maker Ingmar Bergman a startling journey into the darkness of the human soul!
39758: A  lonely composer committed suicide in his apartment in Belgrade. Unaware of the camera catching them, neighbours and other people, shows their inappropriate behavior.

No one is safe from the cruel desires of this inhuman fiend!

Must know what happened that day.

Celebrate the Incredible Strength of Humanity.
